# ffxf_runner_jobs (Data Source)

Lists GitHub Actions runner jobs across all available API pages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

data "ffxf_runner_jobs" "repo" {
  repository = "owner/repo"
  status     = "queued"
  limit      = 25
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Page size from 1 to 100; defaults to the API's default.
- `repository` (String) Filter by GitHub owner/repository.
- `status` (String) Filter by queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, or refused status.

### Read-Only

- `jobs` (Attributes List) Matching runner jobs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Charged amount as a decimal string.
- `completed_at` (String) Completion timestamp.
- `conclusion` (String) GitHub job conclusion, when available.
- `currency` (String) Currency code, when available.
- `free_minutes` (Number) Free minutes applied.
- `github_job_id` (Number) GitHub job identifier.
- `id` (Number) Provider job identifier.
- `job` (String) Job name, when available.
- `label` (String) Requested runner label.
- `minutes` (Number) Billable minutes, when available.
- `queued_at` (String) Queue timestamp.
- `refusal` (String) Reason the job was refused, if applicable.
- `repository` (String) GitHub owner/repository.
- `run_attempt` (Number) Workflow run attempt number.
- `run_id` (Number) GitHub workflow run identifier.
- `started_at` (String) Start timestamp.
- `status` (String) Job status.
- `stopped_for_credit` (Boolean) Whether the job stopped because of credit.
- `url` (String) GitHub job URL.
- `vcpu` (Number) Runner virtual CPU count.
- `waiting_reason` (String) Reason the job is queued, if applicable.
- `workflow` (String) Workflow name, when available.
